prompt:
Pixel-art ground texture for a top-down JRPG map: the rough rocky top of cave walls seen from above: dark violet-grey jagged rock mass, deep cracks, a few stalagmite tips. The square is about 256 x 256 art pixels (each art pixel about 7x7 image pixels).
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Camera: classic top-down RPG map view (seen from above at a steep angle, like a 16-bit era overworld/town map), orthographic, no perspective convergence.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO light sources, NO glow, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
It must be a SEAMLESS TILEABLE texture: the left edge continues into the right edge and the top edge into the bottom edge. Fill the entire square edge to edge with the surface only: no border, no frame, no objects, no characters, no text, no single focal feature, even distribution of detail.
revised_prompt: Generate a square seamless tileable game texture, ground surface for top-down JRPG map: rough rocky TOP surface of cave walls viewed from directly above at steep classic orthographic RPG-map angle. Dark violet-grey jagged rock mass, deep irregular purple-red cracks, a few small angular stalagmite tips integrated in the surface. Entire image filled edge-to-edge, no borders, no scene or objects. Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art, handmade crisp regular square pixels of exactly uniform size, obvious chunky pixel grid (approximately 8x8 output image pixels per art pixel); no anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering/checkerboards. Readable clustered shapes of 3–10 art pixels; hue-shifted rock palette with saturated purple/red shadows, warmer muted yellow-grey highlights, 4–6 tones per material, rich earthy worn texture. Neutral soft even upper-left illumination, clean base colors; no cast shadows, no night darkness, no sources of light, no glow, no pools of light, no vignette. True seamless periodic wrap: features crossing left edge precisely continue at right edge, and top edge precisely continues at bottom edge. Evenly distributed detail, no focal feature. No text, characters, props, frames or border.
